defense.text: PIB confirms Digi Yatra has commenced trials for international passengers at seven airports across India, marking a further step in adoption of digital technology in the aviation sector.

The trials, scheduled to run from November to December 2026, will allow eligible Indian nationals holding e-passports to use Digi Yatra at designated touchpoints on select international flights operated by Air India and IndiGo.

At seven airports in India, trial run of Digi Yatra, the contactless and paperless initiative that relies on facial recognition technology, has been launched for international passengers with wider rollout planned for 2027 after trials conclude by end of December.

Digi Yatra trials for international passengers have begun at seven airports across India, allowing eligible Indian citizens with e-passports to use digital identity verification at designated touchpoints through November and December 2026.
